spans.s:
Eight.
2

Eighth.
n. (-कं)
The eight sections of PĀṆINI'S Grammar.
m. (-कः)
1 The formulae of the Rig Veda as collected into eight portions, thence called Aṣṭakas.
2 One acquainted with PĀṆINI'S rules or the formulae of the Veda.
E.
कन added to अष्ट.

f. (-का)
1 Worship of the manes or progenitors performed on certain days.
2 The eighth day of three months on which the progenitors are worshipped.
E.
अश to eat, and तकन् affix; vegetables, flesh, and cake, being severally offered upon these occasions, and the Brahmins feasted; in this sense it is also अष्टिका.

m. (-र्णः)
A name of BRAHMĀ.
E.
अष्ट eight, and कर्ण an ear; eight-eared, being four-headed.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A kind of board or cloth for playing with dice on.
E.
अष्टक eight, and अङ्ग body, having eight divisions.

m. (-णः)
An octagon.
E.
अष्ट and कोण angle.

m. (-ट् or -त्)
1 A fabulous animal supposed to have eight legs: see शरभ.
2 A spider.

n. (-वं)
A flock of eight cows.
E.
अष्ट and गव kine.

n. (-वं)
A car or wain, one drawn by eight oxen.
E.
अष्ट and गो a cow, अण aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Eight fold.
E.
अष्ट eight, गुण number.

m. plu. (-लाः)
The regents of the cardinal points, as INDRA of the East; VAHNI of the S. E.; YAMA of the South; NAIRṚTA of the S. W.; VARUṆA of the West; MARUT of the N. W.; KUVERA of the North; and ĪŚA of the N. E.
E.
अष्टदिश् the eight points, and पाल who protects.

f. (-दिक्)
The eight cardinal points of the compass collectively.
E.
अष्ट eight, and दिश् quarter.

ind.
Eight fold, eight times.
E.
अष्ट eight, धा aff.

n. (-तु)
The eight metals collectively, as, gold, silver, copper, tin, lead, brass, iron and steel.
E.
अष्ट and धातु a mineral.

mfn. plu. only (अष्ट or अष्टौ)
Eight.
E.
असू to pervade, कनिन Uṇādi affix, and तुद् inserted.

m. (-पात् or -पाद्)
1 A spider.
2 A fabulous animal with eight legs: see शरभ.
(-दः)
A kind of spider with a small body and long legs.
E.
अष्ट eight, and पाद a foot.

mn. (-दः-दं)
1 A kind of chequered cloth or board for drafts, dice, &c.
2 Gold.
m. (-दः)
1 A spider.
2 A fabulous animal with eight legs, the Śarabha.
3 The mountain Kailāsa or abode of

KUVERA.
4

A worm.
5 A pin or bolt.
f. (-दी)
A wild sort of jasmin.
E.
अष्ट eight, and पद a quarter, place, foot, &c. अ being made long.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Quartered by eight, having eight for the root.
E.
अष्टन् and पाद a quarter.

f. (-ष्टी)
A metre consisting of four lines, and having sixteen syllables in each; there are nine species of it.
E.
अष्टन् eight, ङीप् fem. aff.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Eighth.
f. (-मी)
1 The eighth day of the fortnight.
2 A medicinal plant: see क्षीरकाकोली, the last of a class of eight medicinal plants: see अष्टवर्ग.
E.
अष्टन् with डट् affix and मट augment.

m. (-लः)
A horse with a white face, tail, mane, breast, and hoofs.
n. (-लं)
A collection of eight lucky things to be assembled on certain occasions, as at a coronation, &c. as a lion, a bull, an elephant, a water jar, a fan, a flag, a trumpet, and a lamp; or a Brahman, a cow, fire, gold, ghee, the sun, water, and a king.
E.
अष्ट eight, and मङ्गल auspicious.

m. (-शः)
An eighth.
E.
अष्टम and अंश a part.

n. (-नं)
A measure, one Kuḍava.
E.
अष्ट eight, and मान measure.

f. (-का)
A weight of four tolas.
E.
अष्टम eight, कन् added fem. form.

m. (-र्त्तिः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
अष्ट eight, and मूर्त्ति form: evident in the earth, water, &c.

m. (-रः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
अष्टमूर्त्ति an assemblage of eight forms, and धर who has, being identical with the five elements and with the mind, individuality and crude matter.

n. (-कं)
A class of eight metals: gold, silver, copper, tin, lead, and iron of three sorts, including steel.
E.
अष्ट eight, लोहक metal.

m. (-र्गः)
A class of eight principal medicaments, they are mostly the roots of plants from the hills, which have not been determined, and are named: Ṛṣabha, Jīvaka, Meda, Mahāmeda, Ṛddhi, Vṛddhi, Kākolī and Kṣīrakākolī.
E.
अष्ट eight, and वर्ग a class.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Eight fold, of eight kinds.
E.
अष्ट eight, and विध sort.

m. (-वाः)
A name of BRAHMĀ.
E.
अष्ट and श्रवस् an ear; eight-eared.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Prepared in eight pans.
m. (-लः)
1 A sacrifice in which ghee is offered in eight vessels.
E.
अष्ट and कपाल the convexity of a jar.

n. (-ङ्गं)
1 Eight parts of the body, the hands, breast, forehead, eyes, throat and middle of the back; or four first, with the knees and feet; or these six, with the words and mind.
2 Any whole consisting of eight parts or members.
3 The eight parts of a court, or the law, the judge, assessors, scribe and astrologer, gold, fire and water.
3 A die, dice.
E.
अष्ट eight, and अङ्ग a limb.

m. (-यः)
See the above.
E.
अष्टाङ्ग and नय taking.

m. (-तः)
Prostration as in reverence.
E.
अष्टाङ्ग eight members, and पात falling, touching the ground^1 with the hands, knees, and feet, forehead and breast.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-मः)
Profound reverence, prostration with the hands, feet, thighs, breast, eyes, head, words and mind.
E.
अष्टाङ्ग and प्रणाम bowing.

m. (-र्घ्यः)
An offering of eight articles, water, milk, Kusa grass, curds, ghee rice, barley and mustard: or honey, red oleander flowers, and sandal, are substituted for the three last.
E.
अष्ट eight, अङ्ग member, अर्घ्य offering.

mfn. plu. only (-दश)
Eighteen.
E.
अष्ट eight, and दशन् ten.

n. (-त्रं)
gold leaf, a sheet of gold.
E.
अष्टापद and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-वान्)
A Jaina saint and ruler.
E.
अष्ट, अर a period, and चक्रवत् a ruler; such for eight Aras.

n. (-स्रं)
An octagon.
E.
अष्ट and अस्र angle.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Octangular.

n. (-ष्ट्रं)
Æther, the sky or atmosphere.
E.
अस to throw, to send, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
